messages:
lee: Proposal: add a "rules+replay" preview API that can simulate routing + quota effects for a config change. quick mode = rules only, full mode = replay small blob.
indra: +1. need shared evaluator lib so preview logic can't drift.
phil: ops note: cap replay at 1k reqs and queue large runs. also RBAC the full mode.
lee: API: POST /v1/config_preview {config, mode: "rules|replay", blob_id?} -> {id, checksum, summary, confidence}. cache by checksum.
indra: telemetry: preview_match_rate, preview_latency_p95, preview_cost_est_tokens. alert when match_rate < 99.5%.
phil: tests: unit for evaluator, integration that runs blob through prod router shadow and compare. nightly parity job.
lee: rollout: internal only, then opt-in cohorts, then broader. action: lee write doc, indra add metrics, phil add infra quotas.
preview-bot: Preview API design doc uploaded: /internal/designs/preview-runner.md
